facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction flagged off the One Humanitarian - One Poverty Response System on 25 March 2026, centred on a Unified National Register, and committed to integrating all existing programmes into it; no programme link in service is stated.
